definitions.explanation: A medical department or clinic specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of mental health conditions. In Japanese hospitals, this is the department name for psychiatry.

examples.japanese: {精神科|せいしんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{精神科|せいしんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧みたら⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精神科|せいしんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧こと⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抵抗感|ていこうかん}→抵抗感：19364_teikoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, the reluctance toward visiting a psychiatrist has been decreasing.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (mind, spirit) and {科|か} (department, specialty). The standard term for the psychiatry department in Japanese hospitals and clinics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精神科|せいしんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to visit a psychiatrist
- {精神科|せいしんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend psychiatric treatment regularly
- {精神科|せいしんか}{医|い}: psychiatrist
- {精神科|せいしんか}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: psychiatric hospital

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心療|しんりょう}{内科|ないか}→心療内科：30654_shinryounaika⟧: psychosomatic medicine department — treats physical symptoms caused by psychological factors; often perceived as less stigmatized
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}{科|か}→神経科：28050_shinkeika⟧: neurology department — treats neurological conditions (not psychiatric ones)
- ⟦カウンセリング→カウンセリング：10946_kaunseringu⟧: counseling — talk therapy, not necessarily medical

USAGE:
In Japan, some clinics use the name ⟦{心療|しんりょう}{内科|ないか}→心療内科：30654_shinryounaika⟧ (psychosomatic medicine) instead of {精神科|せいしんか} to reduce the stigma associated with psychiatric care. Both departments may treat similar conditions like depression and anxiety.
